articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6 Cyber That Finds 81 Firefox Flaws and Develops 948 Linux Exploits
articles.summary:
OpenAI has launched GPT-6 Cyber, a security-focused AI model that found 81 new high-severity Firefox flaws and built working exploits for 948 Linux kernel bugs. articles.title: Shopify Mandates IP Allowlisting for Public Apps to Prevent Unauthorized Admin API Access
articles.summary:
Shopify is making IP allowlisting mandatory for public apps that call its Admin API, adding a security check to limit the use of stolen access tokens. Developers must enable the control by November 20, 2026, at 11:59 PM ET. Apps using bulk operations face an earlier deadline of November 12 at the same time. The […]

articles.summary:

articles.summary:

articles.title: Hackers Turn Popular Chinese Keyboard Software Into a Backdoor for Cyberespionage Attacks
articles.summary:

articles.title: OpenSSH Flaw Could Let Attackers Bypass Password Authentication on Alpine Linux Servers
articles.summary:
A critical OpenSSH flaw could let remote attackers bypass password authentication on affected Alpine Linux servers, including accounts intended for key-only access. OpenSSH released Portable 10.6p2 on November 5, 2026, to block the issue, which affects Linux systems using musl libc without PAM authentication. articles.title: HYFLOCK Ransomware Encrypts Only First 4KB of Larger Files, Leaves Parts of Victims’ Files Accessible
articles.summary:
HYFLOCK ransomware has an encryption weakness that leaves parts of larger files readable, giving affected organizations a limited chance to recover data without paying attackers. In the October 17 build, the malware encrypted only the first 4,096 bytes of larger files examined during testing, leaving content beyond that section accessible. The finding does not mean […]

articles.title: Researchers Discover White House Network IP Available for Rent Through 28 Proxy Services
articles.summary:
Researchers at Layer3 Intel found that 28 residential proxy services rent addresses on the White House network. Anyone with a few dollars could send web traffic through them.
